correctness.rationale: Lyu--Nie Corollary 4.3 gives exactly the criterion \(p\equiv\pm1\pmod{|q|}\) under the canonical two-bridge hypotheses. For even \(p\ge4\), this makes the admissible positive denominators the shared value \(q=1\) plus the nontrivial proper divisors of \(p-1\) and \(p+1\). Schubert equivalence up to mirror pairs each nontrivial divisor with its complementary divisor, with a fixed orbit exactly when \(p-1\) or \(p+1\) is a square. The summatory estimates use standard elementary divisor and totient arguments. The bundled exact enumeration agrees with the formula for every even \(p\le1000\).

value.rationale: The determinant is a natural complexity measure for two-bridge links because it is the order of the first homology of the double branched cover. The theorem turns a qualitative complete classification into an exact arithmetic census at each determinant and a global rarity law: admissible types grow only on the \(X\log X\) scale while all types grow on the \(X^2\) scale. This exposes a structural factorization mechanism through \(p-1\) and \(p+1\) and quantifies how exceptional non-trivial L-space surgery is inside the full two-bridge population.
